Total style reads rise from 71 to 355 for the 71-source fixture and from 251 to 1255 for the full fixture; the claimed mechanism is separating reads from writes and removing synchronous cold-path host insertion, not eliminating total reads.

rendererFrameMechanismEvidence.interpretation: Read/write ordering and synchronous operation counts do not establish a wall-clock or real-service speedup. The offline plan remains 37 batches with unchanged budget policy.
